question: To whom must all the sprinkled foods be dedicated in the rite?
premises: All foods are sprinkled for purification
The Viśve Devas and ancestors are recipients
inference: After sprinkling all the foods, they are dedicated to the Viśve Devas and the ancestors.
plain_english: Having sprinkled all the foods, to the Viśve Devas and likewise to the ancestors...
